quick_facts.sprint_goal: Managers see live order activity as it happens. Accountants are notified of pending invoices. POS gives immediate audio+visual feedback on payment — eliminating the need to manually refresh any screen.

content.tldr: WebSocket gateway on backend. Frontend WebSocket client. Manager live order feed. Notification bell for accountant. POS audio confirmation on payment.

features_committed.title: WebSocket Real-time Order Feed
features_committed.rationale: Managers in busy stores cannot afford to manually refresh. Real-time visibility reduces errors and disputes.
tasks: T099: OrdersGateway: @WebSocketGateway('/orders') — emit order.created, order.updated events scoped to storeId room
T100: JWT auth guard on WebSocket handshake (same JWT strategy as HTTP)
T101: Frontend: Socket.io-client connection in a useOrderSocket hook
T102: Manager /orders page: live-update list when order.created/updated event received
T103: Active order count badge in sidebar nav (real-time)

features_committed.title: Notification Bell & Alerts
features_committed.rationale: Accountants need to know when new invoices are ready to review. POS sound confirms payment without looking at screen.
tasks: T104: Notification bell icon in AppLayout topnav
T105: Notification store (Zustand): unread count, notification items list
T106: On invoice.created event: push notification to accountant's bell (storeId-scoped)
T107: Notification dropdown: list of 'Hóa đơn #INV-XXXX đã được tạo' items, click → navigate
T108: Mark all as read action
T109: POS page: play audio beep on confirm-payment success (Web Audio API, no external library)
T110: POS page: full-screen green flash + 'Thành công!' overlay for 1.5s on payment confirmed

out_of_scope: Push notifications (browser native push API) — polling + WebSocket sufficient for in-app
WebSocket for product stock updates (post-MVP — no inventory tracking)
prerequisites: Sprint 3: Order + Invoice EventEmitter2 integration stable
Sprint 4: AppLayout topnav in place (notification bell added there)

audit.author: vibe-project-manager
audit.note: Sprint 11 planned. Real-time: WebSocket gateway + frontend hook + notification bell + POS audio feedback.
